scripts.test: bun run test:unit && bun run test:worker
scripts.e2e:serve: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --file test/e2e/seed.sql && bunx wrangler dev --port 8799 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e
scripts.e2e:serve:ingest: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-ingest && bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-ingest --file test/e2e/seed.sql && bunx wrangler dev --port 8789 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-ingest
scripts.e2e:serve:empty: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-empty && bunx wrangler dev --port 8788 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-empty
scripts.e2e:serve:available: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-available && bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-available --file test/e2e/seed.sql && bunx wrangler dev --port 8790 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-available --var NUXT_PUBLIC_HOSTED_STATUS:available
scripts.e2e:serve:unavailable: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-unavailable && bunx wrangler d1 execute DB --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-unavailable --file test/e2e/seed.sql && bunx wrangler dev --port 8791 --persist-to .wrangler/e2e-unavailable --var NUXT_PUBLIC_HOSTED_STATUS:unavailable --var NUXT_PUBLIC_STATS:hidden
